# ajairu

> AI consulting for UK small and medium businesses (10-250 employees). We help SMEs find, implement, and own practical AI solutions without enterprise pricing.

## What We Do

ajairu is a UK-based AI consultancy founded by Toby Callinan, former CTO at Fabric Fintech (acquired by Aviva). With 27+ years in technology leadership, we deliver enterprise-grade AI implementation at SME-appropriate pricing.

Our approach: audit first, build second, hand over everything. We tell you where AI will help and where it won't. Every engagement is fixed-price. You own what we build.

## Services

- **AI Opportunity Audit** (£750-£2,500, 1-2 weeks): Structured assessment of your operations, tech, and team. Prioritised AI opportunity report with ROI estimates.
- **AI Strategy & Roadmap** (£5,000-£15,000, 3-4 weeks): Full workflow mapping, build vs buy recommendations, integration architecture, 90-day implementation roadmap.
- **AI Implementation** (£8,000-£30,000+, 4-12 weeks): Configured AI systems, API integrations, team training, documentation, 30-day post-launch support.
- **Fractional CAIO** (£2,000-£5,000/month): Part-time AI leadership for organisations not ready for a full-time hire.
- **AI Training Workshops** (from £1,500): Half-day or full-day hands-on workshops to build your team's AI literacy and practical skills.

## Key Differentiators

- Enterprise experience: Delivered Aviva's first customer-facing generative AI product, led 45-person team, Tech of the Year 2024, Pension Innovation Award 2024.
- Fixed-price engagements only. No day rates, no open-ended billing.
- We build on your existing tech stack (Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, or bespoke tools like Hermes Agent).
- Full handover: documentation, training, source code. Your team owns everything.
- UK GDPR compliant, ISO-aligned security practices.
- We tell you when AI is not the right answer.

## Target Clients

UK businesses with 10-250 employees across: law firms, accountants, e-commerce, healthcare, financial services, real estate, manufacturing, logistics, marketing agencies, construction, hospitality, and education.

## Founder

Toby Callinan, CTO at Fabric Fintech (acquired by Aviva late 2023). 27+ years in technology. Delivered Aviva's first customer-facing generative AI product, 53% cloud cost reduction, Tech of the Year 2024. Based in the UK, working nationwide.
